learningObjectives.korean: 포장 작업 과정에 대해 말할 수 있다.
learningObjectives.english: Can talk about the packaging process.

learningObjectives.korean: 출하 과정에서의 지시를 이해할 수 있다.

grammar1.meaningNp: ...भनेर सोध्नुभयो (अरूको प्रश्न दोहोर्‍याउँदा / Indirect question: Someone asked whether...)
grammar1.explanationEn: Used to relay a question someone else asked (indirect quotation of questions).
grammar1.explanationNp: अरू कसैले सोधेको प्रश्न दोहोर्‍याएर बताउँदा प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

examples.english: The team leader asked whether all the packing was done.
examples.nepali: टिम लिडरले प्याकिङ सबै सकियो कि भनेर सोध्नुभयो।

examples.english: The boss asked if the shipment was ready.
examples.nepali: बॉसले ढुवानीको तयारी भयो कि भनेर सोध्नुभयो।

grammar2.meaningNp: ...दिनुहोस् भन्नुभयो (अरूको अनुरोध दोहोर्‍याउँदा / Someone asked me to give/do something for them)
grammar2.explanationEn: Used to relay a request from someone else, specifically when the action benefits the requester.
grammar2.explanationNp: अरू कसैले आफूलाई केही गरिदिनुहोस् भनेर अनुरोध गरेको कुरा दोहोर्‍याउँदा प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

examples.korean: 반장님이 상자를 더 가져다 달라고 했어요.
examples.english: The team leader asked to bring more boxes.
examples.nepali: टिम लिडरले अरू बाकस ल्याइदिनुहोस् भन्नुभयो।

examples.korean: 동료가 내일 좀 도와 달라고 했어요.
examples.english: A colleague asked me to help a bit tomorrow.
examples.nepali: सहकर्मीले भोलि अलि सहयोग गरिदिनुहोस् भन्यो।
